description: Implementation of IQ compression and decompression functions for BFP (Block Floating Point) data, including quantization, compression, and decompression of resource blocks with detailed bit manipulation and scaling.

classes.name: iq_compression_bfp_impl
classes.description: Implementation class for IQ compression and decompression using Block Floating Point (BFP) format.

methods.name: quantize_input
methods.description: Converts input BF16 samples to fixed-point int16_t representation and computes RMS for debugging.

methods.name: compress_prb_generic
methods.description: Compresses a resource block of quantized samples into a bit-packed format with exponent scaling.

methods.name: compress
methods.description: Main compression function that converts float IQ data to fixed point and compresses into multiple resource blocks.

methods.name: decompress_prb_generic
methods.description: Decompresses a bit-packed resource block back into IQ samples with scaling.

methods.name: decompress
methods.description: Main decompression function that reconstructs IQ data from compressed resource blocks.
